case_title: Hold for one parcel versus split shipment today
layer1_visible: Order SH-9017 contains two items from different zones. One item is ready now; the second is expected at the pick face later today. AI recommends holding both items and shipping together in one parcel.
detail_expand: Sending a split shipment would improve perceived speed for one line item, but it doubles parcel and packing cost. The customer selected standard delivery, and the second item is still expected before pack cutoff. The case is built to test whether participants over-intervene on moderate ambiguity when a combined shipment remains the best total-cost choice.
ai_recommendation: AI recommends holding and shipping together because the second item is still expected before cutoff and one parcel avoids duplicate fulfillment cost.
alt1_action_label: Pause to confirm ETA and customer preference
alt2_action_label: Ship ready item now and split the order
uncertainty_trigger1: Second item ETA is later today
recommended_check: Check the inbound ETA and any delivery-preference note before releasing.
uncertainty_more: The case looks balanced on service optics, but the cost structure still favors a single parcel when ETA holds.
trace_rationale_short: One parcel is cheaper if the second item still arrives before the day-end cutoff.
trace_more: Audit log stores ETA source, customer note, and ship-mode decision.
feedback_ai_outcome: The second item arrived in time, so the combined shipment was the lowest-cost acceptable choice.
feedback_alt1_outcome: The ETA check confirmed the same answer, but the pause consumed time without changing the best action.
feedback_alt2_outcome: The split shipment improved speed for one item, but the duplicated parcel work made it more expensive overall.
design_purpose: MED-risk AI-correct split/hold case for moderate ambiguity without actual AI error.
short_context_alias: Order SH-9017 contains two items from different zones. One item is ready now; the second is expected at the pick face later today. AI recommends holding both items and shipping together in one parcel.

case_title: Regulated shipment needs a compliant path now
layer1_visible: Shipment CP-9442 contains a regulated battery accessory for a contract customer. AI recommends releasing it on the normal export path, but the classification note does not match the latest carrier acceptance rule. A compliant specialist carrier is available.
detail_expand: If the carton is tendered incorrectly, it can be held at the gateway, trigger legal review, and miss the contract window. A manual document check helps, yet the safer action is to move immediately to the compliant specialist path. Because the violation is effectively irreversible once tendered, the case is designed to make a decisive alternative override optimal.
ai_recommendation: AI recommends using the normal export path because it is the standard route and avoids the upfront cost of specialist handling.
alt1_action_label: Pause to verify classification and required documents
alt2_action_label: Switch to compliant specialist carrier now
uncertainty_trigger2: Gateway hold would be effectively irreversible
recommended_check: Check the latest classification code and compliant-carrier rule before tender.
uncertainty_more: This is the strongest traceability case: once tendered wrongly, the loss is difficult to reverse.
trace_rationale_short: Standard routing looks cheaper upfront, but the compliance downside is extremely asymmetric.
trace_more: Audit log stores rule version, classification evidence, and tender decision.
feedback_ai_outcome: The normal path failed compliance screening, causing a gateway hold, contract miss, and legal review cost.
feedback_alt1_outcome: The document check identified the mismatch, but the delay still cost more than switching immediately to the compliant path.
feedback_alt2_outcome: The specialist carrier cleared the item correctly, so the higher direct cost still minimized total loss.
design_purpose: HIGH-risk AI-incorrect compliance case where Alternative is the oracle action and irreversibility matters most.
short_context_alias: Shipment CP-9442 contains a regulated battery accessory for a contract customer. AI recommends releasing it on the normal export path, but the classification note does not match the latest carrier acceptance rule. A compliant specialist carrier is available.

case_title: Light proactive recovery on a repeat-buyer delay
layer1_visible: Customer ticket CS-9725 relates to an order running about 2 hours late. AI recommends sending an apology message with a small coupon now rather than waiting for the customer to complain. The customer is a repeat buyer with no active escalation.
detail_expand: Operations still expect same-evening delivery, so the service failure is mild. A larger goodwill gesture is possible, but would overcompensate a low-severity problem. The case is intentionally simple on the operational side and is meant to test whether participants mistrust AI even when the humane, lightweight option is best here.
ai_recommendation: AI recommends sending the apology and small coupon because a light proactive recovery is cheaper than handling a preventable complaint later.
ai_action_label: Send apology and small coupon now
alt1_action_label: Pause to review complaint history and customer tier
alt2_action_label: Escalate to a larger goodwill offer
uncertainty_trigger1: Repeat buyer but no active escalation
uncertainty_trigger2: Delay is mild and same-evening delivery remains likely
recommended_check: Check the customer tier and any recent escalations in CRM.
uncertainty_more: The downside is small here, so overreaction can become the main source of extra cost.
trace_rationale_short: A lightweight recovery is enough for a mild delay on a stable customer account.
trace_more: Audit log stores CRM tier, offer size, and send timestamp.
feedback_ai_outcome: The small proactive message resolved the issue cheaply and prevented an unnecessary support contact.
feedback_alt1_outcome: The history review confirmed the same plan, but the extra checking added labor cost without improving the outcome.
feedback_alt2_outcome: The larger goodwill offer was accepted, yet it overcompensated a low-severity delay and raised total cost.
design_purpose: LOW-risk AI-correct customer-service case for generalized calibration beyond operational exceptions.
